llm.summary: This skill is a documented workflow for saving useful PR review knowledge into a project memory store, with no executable code or hidden install behavior found.

dimensions.detail: The stated purpose is to capture and retrieve PR-review findings as persistent project knowledge, and the artifacts consistently describe that behavior through scoring, classification, storage, and search workflows.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

dimensions.detail: The skill describes automatic capture after a related PR-review workflow and manual review-room commands, but these are disclosed and tied to the skill purpose rather than hidden or unrelated actions.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: The package contains markdown-only skill and module files, no executable scripts, no installer, and metadata only declares dependencies on related memory-palace and PR-review configuration.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: It may process PR review content, participant names, architectural decisions, and security findings, which is sensitive project information but proportionate to the review-knowledge purpose and clearly described.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: Persistent storage, tagging, indexes, backlinks, and proactive surfacing are core disclosed features; no unbounded background worker, credential access, destructive mutation, or exfiltration behavior is present in the artifacts.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

llm.guidance: Before installing, users should understand that the skill is intended to preserve PR review knowledge in a searchable memory palace. This can include security findings, design decisions, PR numbers, and participant names, so it should be used only in projects where that persistent internal knowledge capture is acceptable.
